_provenance: Captured from the live arcade (MAME `sonson`, NTSC) in real md=02 gameplay via the verified coin->start path + spriteram log at $2020. Scripts: D:/portForge/tools/mame/ss_pdeath_cap.lua (player death, forced by running into enemies without firing -> 6 deaths), ss_pdeath_all.lua (all-sprite dump confirming NO player death sprite plays), ss_edeath_cap.lua + ss_edeath2.lua (enemy deaths, fire-hard while pinning grace $0073 -> 32 walker death-tails). Codes/banks confirmed distinct + non-blank via tools/sheet_browse.py. Spriteram decode: code=byte2+((attr&0x20)<<3), bank=attr&0x1F.

player_death.summary: The arcade SonSon hero has NO on-screen death-tumble. On a lethal hit the player sprite VANISHES instantly (pc 1->0) for ~4 frames, then RESPAWNS holding sprite code 83 (the standby/arms pose) for ~17 frames at the re-entry point before resuming the RUN cycle (64/65/80). On the final life it stays gone (game over).
player_death.note: Sprite-sheet codes 74-77 are scrambled/garbage (not poses); 88-90 are decorative title sprites. There is NO dedicated player death/tumble sprite in the ROM -- the vanish IS the death. Faithful PLAYER_DEATH therefore = hold pose 83 (what the arcade shows at the death/respawn beat); the engine already blinks the player during FLOW_DYING.

walker_death.comment: bank 2 ground walker (walk 304/305/306). DEATH-by-shot, captured 32x, canonical = collapse then a long-held corpse then an explosion-scatter when the slot clears.

flyer_death.comment: bank 9 green flyer (fly loop 96..109). The flyer has its OWN distinct death burst 110..119 (green-body parts + YELLOW SPARKS, visually different from the walker's white-armor debris) -- sheet-verified via sheet_browse.py bank 9. Headless AI could not reliably SHOOT an evasive gliding flyer, so the live cadence was not captured; frame ORDER is authoritative (the sheet), the cadence is modeled on the captured walker-burst timing (fast early frames, the scatter held a touch longer).
flyer_death.cadence_source: frame order = arcade sprite sheet (authoritative); per-frame durations modeled on the captured walker death burst (TODO: capture the live flyer-death cadence by intercepting a flyer).
